scripts.build: node scripts/fetch-news.mjs && next build && node scripts/gen-deploy-files.mjs
scripts.analyze: next build && node -e "const{readdirSync,statSync}=require('fs');const p='out/_next/static/chunks';let t=0;readdirSync(p).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')).map(f=>({f,s:statSync(p+'/'+f).size})).sort((a,b)=>b.s-a.s).slice(0,12).forEach(x=>{t+=x.s;console.log((x.s/1024).toFixed(1).padStart(8)+' KB  '+x.f)});console.log('\ntop-12 total: '+(t/1024).toFixed(1)+' KB raw')"
